blueprint.label: Factory: 1 chemical-science-pack/s, compact
blueprint.description: 9 rows on shelves, products handed over directly. Inputs enter at the bottom of the west bus, west to east: steel-plate 1/s, coal 1.5/s, iron-plate 7/s, copper-plate 7.5/s; by pipe: petroleum-gas 37.5/s, water 7.5/s. The product leaves at the top. Connect any pole to your grid.
